# Design System a11y

This is a machine-readable design system based on the Design Tokens Specification (2025.10). It is designed to be consumed by agentic AI workflows to ensure consistent, accessible, and standards-compliant UI implementation.

## Core Assets
- [Design Tokens (JSON)](tokens.json): The single source of truth for all visual constants.
- [Visual Documentation](index.html): Human-readable gallery of the tokens.

## Token Naming Convention
Tokens follow a semantic naming pattern:
`--sys-[category]-[property]-[modifier]`

Example: `--sys-color-bg-primary`

## Accessibility Baseline
All tokens are validated against WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements.
